column1: # Rows db.dxs.* (line RG series D, item xml-stream, 2026-11-27; remaining-gaps DECISIONS D-SO-2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/logs/xml_stream/NCBI.md): BLAST XML (outfmt 5) and the XML2 and JSON documents (16, 15) are written batch by batch, so a title that LOSAT refuses (one NCBI's definition line generator reads past the end of, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS) in a later query batch comes after the output of the batches before (OWNER_DECISIONS 44 + D-SO-2/D-SO-6, Owner-delegated; the form of Q-X2c), without the document's end: BATCH_SIZE=1 with na then a query whose title is punctuation (tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_pq.fna, against tests/fasta/outfmt0/xsb_s.fna) or then r, which hits only a subject whose title is punctuation (tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_r.fna against tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_s.fna); the near rows are na alone against each subject file (db.xs.blastn.bat.na.5 is the near row of outfmt 5 against xsb_s.fna). Where LOSAT refuses a -subject 15/16 report, it is refused where NCBI makes that report, after the reports before it in any batch layout, and a refused first report writes nothing (remaining-gaps DECISIONS D-SO-6, Owner-delegated 2026-11-27; review H3/H4/M1 of round ad-RG-D-41): one query batch (ttl1, stl1; outfmt 5 refuses its one batch before the first byte), the first report (ttf, tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_pq_na.fna) and a refused query in the middle of the second of two batches of two (tmb, tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_nb_pq_nc.fna against the near rows nanb of tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_na_nb.fna). The same one rule with -db and for every XML2 and JSON form (remaining-gaps DECISIONS D-SO-8, Owner-delegated 2026-11-28; re-review M1/M2 of round ad-RG-D-42): NCBI makes a -db report when its query's result arrives, so its refusal comes after the reports before it in any batch layout (rows d*, against the database tests/db_search/dxs_n of tests/fasta/outfmt0/dxs_s.fna; near rows dna, dnanb of the same database), and NCBI opens the side file of a refused report of 14 and 13 before it makes the report: that file stays empty, the side files before it are whole and the master is empty, also where NCBI crashes, so those rows take NCBI's files of their own run (db_search_fixtures.py `rejection_files`). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program blastn --only db.dxs.`.
